task.text:
[0] Age was counted from the first day of the adulthood. Worms were threated with 2 mM IPTG during the development. Beginning from the first day of the adulthood, they were transferred in the 0.1 mg/ml FUDR containing media.

[1] Overexpression of Akt promoted early death in flies. In contrast, downregulation of Akt by RNAi showed no effect on longevity.

[2] Recombinant mouse serum albumin (rMSA) improved the lifespan and healthspan of mice (preprint). p=0,0342

[3] Recombinant mouse serum albumin (rMSA) improved the lifespan and healthspan of mice (preprint). p=0,0164

[4] Recombinant mouse serum albumin (rMSA) improved the lifespan and healthspan of mice (preprint). p=0,0019

[5] Mis-expression of ANK2 causes a reduction in lifespan, movement, memory, and neuronal excitability.

[6] Mis-expression of ANK2 causes a reduction in lifespan, movement, memory, and neuronal excitability.

[7] The age was counted from the first day of adulthood. 25 µg/ml of carbenicillin, and 1 mM IPTG were added to the culture media. No FUDR was added.

[8] APOE knockout mice had severe atherosclerosis and xanthomatosis, 35% of them died within 18 months.

[9] P < 0.001 The triglyceride and cholesterol levels in the liver were considerably higher in knockout males (measured at 20 weeks old) than in control males when the mice were fed high-fat diet (HFD). When male mice were fed HFD, the weight of liver in the knockout group was markedly greater than that in the control group. These changed were not observed in knockout males with standard diet or in female knockout mice. Blood glucose levels in knockout males (measured at 20 weeks old) fed with HFD were significantly higher than those in HFD-fed control males at all times points after the glucose challenge. Insulin sensitivity (i.e., the decrease of blood glucose levels after insulin injection) was lower in knockout mice than that in the corresponding controls. These changed were not observed in knockout males with standard diet or in female knockout mice.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
